name: Epsilon Eridani
tagline: The nearest Sun-like star with a debris disk — a young solar system in the making.
history: Epsilon Eridani is what our Solar System may have looked like at 800 million years old — a young K2 star ringed by two asteroid belts and an outer comet cloud, with at least one Jupiter-mass planet plowing through the dust. It is the closest Sun-like star with confirmed planets, close enough that interstellar dust maps show a cavity where its system sweeps the medium clean. Frank Drake pointed the first SETI search here in 1960.
